name: Status indicator
purpose: A small coloured dot + label giving a visual cue of a background update or state change, making the user aware of relevant activity. RAG-coded across approved / cancelled / declined / pending, with a disabled (muted) variant.

props.name: state
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C1 -- no-bind:state-selector. A state enum selects among per-state token SETS (colour-semantic); per-state maps are the colour-spine lane's job (not yet migrated). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

tokens.label: text/default (#333) @ font-6/regular
tokens.disabled-dot: rag/success-tint / rag/error-tint / rag/warning-tint for approved/declined/pending; cancelled disabled uses non-interactive (depricate)/surface/neutral-3 (no rag/neutral-tint exists — see tokenValidation)
tokens.$finding: (2026-06-19) rag/warning (#FFBB33) is ~1.6:1 on a white page — the amber dot fails 1.4.11 (3:1) in LIGHT mode. Acceptable only because the text label carries the status (1.4.1); a stand-alone status dot would need an outline or an icon. success/error/information dots pass 3:1 both modes.

commonPatterns: status dot + label on a row

accessibility.useOfColour: Status MUST NOT be conveyed by the dot colour alone — the text label (approved/cancelled/declined/pending) carries the meaning (1.4.1)
accessibility.announce: Background status changes should be announced to AT (aria-live) since the component signals updates
accessibility.contrast: Dot + label must meet non-text/text contrast; the amber 'pending' needs care on light surfaces

antiPatterns: Relying on the dot colour alone without the text label
Using status indicators for interactive actions (they are non-interactive cues)
Leaving the cancelled-disabled dot on the deprecated neutral-3 token — the real fix is to add a rag/neutral-tint (see tokenValidation)

forms.$note: TWO TAXONOMIES LIVE HERE, DELIBERATELY. The A/B/C keys below are the ORIGINAL 2026-06-22 promotion forms (inline / tint chip / live-announced). The G17_* keys are the s212-D2 canon manifestation set (dot+label / filled cell / bar). They are NOT the same letters and neither is renamed — the G17_ prefix is the disambiguator. See $g17.
forms.A_inline_dot_label: round dot (aria-hidden) + text/default label; the label carries meaning (1.4.1). Minimal/inline form.
forms.B_square_tint_chip: rag/*-tint surface + dot + text/default label, border-radius:0. Fully AA (labels 11-19:1). THE SAME PRIMITIVE used as the status detail in List items transaction rows.
forms.C_live_announced: role=status + aria-live region + a control that changes the status — demonstrates 4.1.3 (the component's actual job).
forms.G17_A_status_indicator: The dot + label form — EXISTING CANON, unchanged by s212-D2. Surface map: inline / lists / anywhere a single status sits in text. Implemented by A_inline_dot_label above.
forms.G17_B_filled_cell: The salience-ramp FILL rung: the whole cell carries the status. Surface map: status columns in dense tables and dashboards, where scan speed matters. Fill = rag/*-background; ink = rag/text/on-light (error, warning) / text/on-success (success) / rag/text/on-information (information), the Banner precedent. Neutral/cancelled has NO fill leg (no rag/neutral-background token) and falls back to G17_A.
forms.G17_C_bar_edge: Left-edge accent (4px) on a surface/subtle ground. Surface map: cards and grouped rows where the WHOLE object has a status. Edge binds the bare rag role (the dot's value); the label inside the bar carries the meaning (icon-013).
